$comment: Advisories accepted for the apps/web dependency tree, consumed by scripts/ci/audit-gate.ts.
An entry here does NOT silence the advisory: the gate still prints it on every run.
It records a reviewed judgement that the advisory is not actionable today, and the date
on which that judgement stops being valid. Past reviewBy, the gate blocks again.
Only high and critical advisories are gated; moderate and low are reported only.
Rules: every entry states what was checked, not just a conclusion. No entry may be added
for an advisory whose vulnerable code path is reachable in production.
Policy and triage procedure: docs/SECURITY.md section 6.
